listing.name: Duke Nukem II / Rigel Engine (lethal-guitar)
listing.summary: Play Duke Nukem II with widescreen, smooth scrolling and Rigel Engine’s mod support.

steps.title: Use the Rigel Engine player
steps.instruction: Use the native package for your system. The Windows runtime ZIP contains RigelEngine.exe; upstream’s platform instructions cover Debian packages and the macOS application. Keep your original game files in their own folder.

steps.title: Select your Duke Nukem II files
steps.instruction: On first Play, choose your Duke Nukem II folder containing NUKEM2.CMP. Shareware and registered editions work. Keep the optional NUKEM2.F1–F5 intro movies with it for movie playback; Rigel Engine remembers your choice.

warnings: Rigel Engine imports existing saves, high scores and settings into its own user profile. Keep that profile and your mod files backed up when updating the upstream installation.
